title: Dotted flow

reference.source: Reference 24: pointillist flow print in teal, red and cream on dark gray, 640 × 960 px PNG.
reference.note: held locally; this page carries statistics measured from it and none of its pixels

summary: Rows of round dots along the streamlines of one wave flow, staggered row to row, each dot colored by runs along its row, red or cream or teal by zone.
units: reference pixels; the plate is 640 × 960 and every length scales with the canvas

pitch.does: Spacing of dots along a row; the reference's nearest-neighbor spacing is 6.3 px.

rows.does: Distance between rows across the flow.

radius.does: Radius of every dot; the reference's components have a median area of 21 px.

stagger.does: Offset of every second row by half a pitch; 1 packs the dots hexagonally, 0 aligns them in columns.

jitter.does: Random offset of each dot from its place on the row.

vary.does: Per-dot variation of size and tint.

grain.does: Speckle of the dark ground between the dots.

wave.does: Swing of the main wave the rows follow.

wavelength.does: Length of one full wave; a second wave at 0.43 of this length rides on it.

turbulence.does: Slow noise warp of the coordinates, so the rows wander off the clean sine.

run.does: Length of the color runs along a row.

red.does: Share of red dots where the zone field favors red.

cream.does: Share of cream dots where the zone field favors cream.

seed.does: Re-rolls the warp, the runs and the zones.

modes.saw: value up to value + amp over period seconds, then again
modes.drift: seeded walk, one step of up to amp every period seconds, folded back at the slider ends

motion.runs: only while Motion is on, at half scale; the sliders hold the center values; off by default

live.runs: only while Live is on: a drag on the figure sets x across and y down between these ends; off by default

techniques.name: Flow
techniques.implementation: Rows bending with the flow: every dot the same 5 px, spacing 6.4 px along and across.

techniques.name: Grain
techniques.implementation: Hexagonal packing where the rows run straight: each dot has six neighbors.

techniques.name: Tone
techniques.implementation: A red zone: runs of red dots along the rows, teal dots between the runs.

techniques.name: Pull
techniques.implementation: Cream rows: a run of cream dots reads as a bright streamline.

techniques.name: Edge
techniques.implementation: A run boundary: the color changes mid-row, dot to dot, with no blend.

techniques.name: Paper
techniques.implementation: Ground: dark gray with a speckle of 6 levels, showing in the 1 px gaps between dots.

pass_order: flow: tilted coordinates warped by slow noise, a stream function of two sines; rows are its level sets at a fixed spacing, with arc length along them tabulated
dots: along every row at a fixed pitch, every second row offset by half a pitch (hexagonal packing); each dot jittered and sized by a hash
color: runs along the row from a 1-D noise, with a slow zone field setting whether red, cream or teal leads; three teal shades by hash
ground: dark gray with a speckle; every pixel takes the nearest dot's color through a soft edge

dot_component_area_px.method: connected components of pixels above L 75

measured.lattice_evidence: autocorrelation of the dot mask peaks at 6.4, 12.8 and 19.2 px along one direction

benchmark.computed: live, when this page loads, by the code that measured the reference: default parameters, Teal, red, cream palette, 1× reference size

setup.note: The flow is generated, so the red field, cream rows and teal field rects were placed with search.py; the whole plate compares in place.

limits: Under 98 %: the tone histograms (0.72 to 0.8), the red field's spectrum and the lag 3 to 7 autocorrelation. The reference's dots sit on a looser lattice than a jittered hexagonal one, so its autocorrelation decays to zero by lag 4 where the rebuild's rebounds at lag 6 to 7; its red rows also cluster at a larger scale than the 420 px zone field.
The flow is an original arrangement; the reference's zones of red, cream and teal are not placed where its are, so the field rects are searched.
Dots that fall below L 75 (the darkest teals) were not separated by the component measure, so the dot radius may be read slightly small.
notes: Deterministic: the same palette, parameters and seed give the same pixels.
A display render is capped at 2.4 megapixels; a slider in motion draws at half scale (down to a quarter on a heavy engine) and the release redraws in full.
This spec follows the controls: open it again, or leave it open, after changing them.
